Q: JavaPos for an application. Service does not exist in loaded JCL registry A:

You got the error because of invalid device name you specified to open.

try this:

String deviceName = "HPPrinter" // or what your device name is
printer.open(deviceName);

instead of:

printer.open("printf");

Q: How to create multiple connection at same time in Android bluetooth low energy (BLE)? A:

You are going to handle each BLE device by creating each BluetoothGattCallback for each one. for example like: 

private final BluetoothGattCallback oneGattcallback = new BluetoothGattCallback() ...

private final BluetoothGattCallback twoGattcallback = new BluetoothGattCallback() ...

then try to connect mBluetoothGattA = deviceA.connectGatt(this, false, oneGattcallback ); and mBluetoothGattB = deviceB.connectGatt(this, false, twoGattcallback ); just like that. you will find a lot examples handle one connection and just develop more for multiple connection. Besides, checkout this video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qx55Sa8UZAQ show that max concurrent GATT connections is (4) Android 4.5 and (7) Android 4.4+

Q: Does dynamic_cast violate LSP? A:

As I said, you can use dynamic_cast to safely downcast. I am not aware of a priciple that this would break.

You can also use it like you did in your function and if, as Igor suggested, you have a class C: public A, public B then func even has a chance to do call both methods (It would still be too easy to be used wrong).

Anyhow, dynamic_cast itself doesn't break principles. It's rather that if you violate eg LSP, then you will find yourself in the need of a dynamic_cast very often.
